title: Baby Doll Juby says backlash on Donny Pangilinan dream a ‘learning experience’
summary: Juby of girl group Showtime Baby Dolls has finally addressed the criticism aimed at her after sharing a “dream” that supposedly involved a sexual encounter with her celebrity crush, actor…

blocks.text: Juby of girl group Showtime Baby Dolls has finally addressed the criticism aimed at her after sharing a “dream” that supposedly involved a sexual encounter with her celebrity crush, actor Donny Pangilinan. Juby spoke about the issue during the group’s guest appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Thursday, Nov. 5, after show host Abunda asked what she had learned from the backlash that she recently faced. “I would say na it hit me on my rock bottom. Parang ang dami ko pong realizations. And since kaka-start lang po namin, I would consider that a learning experience ko po and […]...
